label: Finding-21
title: kev-precedent: Honeypot attempts count as 'exploited in the wild' for 2024 but not for php2shell
description: Akamai's one-day evidence is exploit attempts against its honeypot network, the same kind of evidence as Amazon's MadPot hits, which the site's notes (amazon-honeypot, history.json) say are 'attempts against honeypots, not compromises'. Apply one standard to both.
